description: Replace the hardcoded 'apps' count display with proper internationalization and pluralization support. The feature should display the number of installed apps with correct singular/plural forms across all supported languages, using existing translation keys already available in locale files.
functional_requirements: Replace the hardcoded string '${installedAppsNumber} apps' with a call to the translation system using the 'number_apps' key
Implement proper pluralization handling that displays '1 app' for singular and '2 apps' (or appropriate translations) for plural counts
Ensure the solution works across all supported locales by leveraging existing 'number_apps_one' and 'number_apps_other' translation keys
Maintain functionality in both desktop and mobile layouts of the Apps tab on the event types page
Remove the TODO comment that previously flagged this internationalization issue
